title: Rust: implement real Yggdrasil AddrForKey algorithm
description:
Update ygg_addr_from_pubkey in Rust to match exact Yggdrasil algorithm:
1. Invert pubkey bits
2. Count leading 1-bits
3. Build address per yggdrasil-go AddrForKey()

Breaking change. Must match Python implementation exactly.
Update any /8 references to /7.
close_reason: Already landed by i72x.2. rust/lichen-core/src/addr.rs:119 ygg_addr_from_pubkey implements upstream yggdrasil-go AddrForKey exactly (bit-invert, leading-1 count wrapping mod 256, separator skip, MSB-first bit-pack discarding trailing partial byte, 0x02 prefix) with doc citing yggdrasil-go 422836ee; lichen-gateway trust.rs:497 delegates to it. Pinned oracle: test/vectors/yggdrasil_address.json upstream_addr_for_key anchor consumed by lichen-core tests yggdrasil_addr_vectors.rs + ipv6_address_vectors.rs:221 and lichen-link identity.rs:160; verified green (4+5 pass). The bead's '/8 -> /7 rename' tail is overtaken by the settled upstream-yggdrasil-addressing decision: 0200::/7 is the aggregate, node /128s stay in 0200::/8 — current /8 terminology is correct and was left alone.
